# Sorrel Court Catering - kitchen workspace

Shared folder for the prep team.

- kitchen/  prep cards for the menu
- events/  function sheets for the week

turns.prompt: A chef at Sorrel Court asked what the yield figure on a prep card means; it is the share of a whole item that survives trimming. A whole ribeye weighs 6.8 kilograms and the card gives a yield of 78 percent. Give the usable mass in kilograms. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
